title: Classic Ethiopian-Style Atakilt Wat
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish made with cabbage, carrots, potatoes, onions, and a flavorful spice blend. This recipe is a hearty, comforting meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onions and sauté until they are translucent.
Add the cabbage, carrots, and potatoes. Stir to combine.
Add the Ethiopian Spice Blend and stir to combine.
Cook for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
